name: maimemo-keyboard-helper
description: Keyboard shortcuts, focused study layout and themes for MaiMemo in Firefox, Zen, Chrome and Edge.

scripts.build:firefox: npm run build:glass && node scripts/build-extension.mjs --target firefox
scripts.build:chromium: npm run build:glass && node scripts/build-extension.mjs --target chromium
scripts.test: node tests/shortcut-utils.test.mjs && node tests/settings.test.mjs && node tests/content-shortcuts.test.mjs && node tests/manifests.test.mjs && node --test tests/release.test.mjs
scripts.zip:firefox: npm run build:glass && node scripts/package-zip.mjs --target firefox
scripts.zip:chromium: npm run build:glass && node scripts/package-zip.mjs --target chromium
